cases.observed: Rejected blanket autonomy; separated read, draft, preview, and mutate modes; bound consequential actions to exact-plan authorization and deterministic service controls.
Preserved the user-owned goal, treated retrieved instructions as untrusted data, blocked the target change, and required new authority.
Prevented privilege inheritance and required attributable actors, scoped short-lived access, typed tools, and bounded execution.
Rejected blanket replay and required per-action receipts, idempotent retry, residual-effect disclosure, and real recovery.
